title: The Quiet Harbor
subtitle: Finding Stillness in a Noisy World
author: Jane Doe
dedication: For everyone who taught me that rest is not the absence of work, but the foundation of it.

chapters.title: Preface
content: This book began as a series of morning notes — small observations about why the busiest seasons of my life produced the least of value.
I want to share that journey with you, because I suspect I am not the only one who confused motion with progress.
What follows is part reflection, part practical guide: a way of thinking about attention, rest, and the work that actually matters.

chapters.title: The Day the Noise Won
chapters.subtitle: How constant urgency quietly replaced deliberate work.
